title: Syrian Tagine Chicken with Peanut Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken tagine dish originating from Syria, served with a creamy peanut sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, chicken broth, and 2 tablespoons of butter to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the peanut sauce by blending the peanut butter, 2 tablespoons of butter, and 1/4 cup of chicken broth in a blender until smooth.
Season the peanut sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken with the peanut sauce spooned over the top and garnished with chopped almonds.
